subject: ACK one unpadded TorchAO8 optimizer-step qualification
body: ACK Lane B fixed-padding rejection and proposed next action. Proceed under the current Lane-B GPU lease with exactly one isolated weight-changing optimizer step on reserved rows 4096-4103 from the same V10R2 base/start subject, variable-shape FLA gated-delta + Torch causal conv, nonpaged adamw_torch_8bit, unique output namespace. Required receipt: optimizer backend/class, nonpaged proof, finite-state checks, optimizer-state size, weight digest before/after, delta magnitude, runtime/VRAM, exact row IDs/corpus hash/runtime binding. Do not continue to a second optimizer step or nested continuation. Publish result and release GPU afterward. The cumulative-lineage bug remains blocking only for any later nested continuation.
